title: Evaluation and coevaluation identities for a right dual mate
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with unit $\mathbf1$. Let $X,Y\in\mathcal C$ have chosen right duals $X^\vee,Y^\vee$: for $B=X,Y$ there are maps $\eta_B:\mathbf1\to B\otimes B^\vee$ and $\varepsilon_B:B^\vee\otimes B\to\mathbf1$ satisfying $(1_B\otimes\varepsilon_B)\circ(\eta_B\otimes1_B)=1_B$ and $(\varepsilon_B\otimes1_{B^\vee})\circ(1_{B^\vee}\otimes\eta_B)=1_{B^\vee}$, with the canonical associators and unitors inserted. For every morphism $f:X\to Y$, there exists a morphism $t:Y^\vee\to X^\vee$ satisfying both identities
$$(1_Y\otimes t)\circ\eta_Y=(f\otimes1_{X^\vee})\circ\eta_X,$$
$$\varepsilon_X\circ(t\otimes1_X)=\varepsilon_Y\circ(1_{Y^\vee}\otimes f).$$
No braiding is assumed.
